title: discoveryengine.googleapis.com/agentregistry/connector
description: Gemini Enterprise (Discovery Engine) connector metadata. Present on the McpServer of a resource backed by a Gemini Enterprise connector. Every field is optional.

type.description: The type of the Gemini Enterprise connector, as a lowercase hyphen-separated identifier: for example 'github', 'atlassian-rovo'. Instances of the same connector share a type; it identifies which external service the connector integrates with.

version.description: The version of the connector definition this instance was created from, for example '1.0'.

state.description: The provisioning state of the connector instance. Some possible values are: 'STATE_UNSPECIFIED', 'INITIALIZING', 'INITIALIZED', 'INITIALIZATION_FAILED', 'ACTIVE', 'RUNNING', 'FAILED', 'WARNING', 'UPDATING' or 'DELETING'.

instanceUri.description: The customer's own site, for connectors addressed per customer: for example 'https://acme.atlassian.net'. This is the tenant the connector reads from, and differs from the MCP endpoint in 'interfaces', which is the same for every customer of a given connector. Absent for connectors that address a single fixed endpoint.

tenantId.description: The identifier of the customer tenant within the external service, where the service requires one to address it.

skills.description: The Agent Registry skill revisions a Gemini Enterprise administrator added to this custom MCP connector, one entry per skill, at most five. Absent for other connectors and for custom MCP connectors without any.

skill.description: The resource name of the skill, in the form 'projects/{project_number}/locations/{location}/skills/{skill}'.

revision.description: The resource name of the skill revision, in the form 'projects/{project_number}/locations/{location}/skills/{skill}/revisions/{revision}'.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the skill revision's payload, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
